title: eranthemum capense var. wightianum
intro: Eranthemum capense var. wightianum, commonly known as Wight's Lantana, is a plant species in the family Lamiaceae. It is used in traditional medicine due to its health benefits, which include anti-inflammatory, antimicrobial, and antioxidant properties. The therapeutic actions of Eranthemum capense var. wightianum include wound healing, antiseptic, and antifungal activities, making it a potential remedy for various skin conditions. The bioactive constituents of this plant are primarily flavonoids and phenolic acids, which contribute to its medicinal properties.
